thread.title: Stock Market Rallies, Then Fades; This Dow Jones Stock Surges | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Rallies, Then Fades; This Dow Jones Stock Surges | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes erased a rebound in today's stock market . The Nasdaq had turned negative until New York Fed President John Williams stressed that future Fed rate hikes would be data dependent and that "listening" to the stock market would be part of that.
X But by 11:15 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones industrial average pared a gain of 300 points to 38. Blue-chip stock Nike ( NKE ) soared after its strong earnings results. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Major Stock Indexes Climb To End Tumultuous Week The Dow Jones industrials were up 0.2% after powering up 1.2%, and the S&P 500 index erased a 1% gain and was 0.1% lower. The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite lagged with a 0.8% decline. The Nasdaq's fall on Thursday crossed into in a bear market when it fell more than 20% off its highs before recovering.
The stock market sold off in afternoon trade Wednesday and again Thursday after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates and said it would continue to reduce the size of its balance sheet. Meanwhile, fears over a government shutdown exacerbated the stock market's issues. Early Friday, it was reported that the U.S. economy grew at a 3.4% annual rate in the third quarter, slightly lower than the 3.5% consensus estimate .
New York Fed President John Williams didn't saying anything particularly different to what the Fed and Fed Chairman Jerome Powell said Wednesday, but his Friday comments on CNBC still seemed to soothe markets.
The major stock indexes hit new lows for the year with the stock market trend in correction mode. Investors should be focusing on stocks that are holding up the best amid the volatile action.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Stock Market Earnings: Dow Stock Nike Soars Dow Jones stock Nike jumped after its strong earnings and sales results after the stock market close Thursday. The company's results highlighted the retailer's success in North America with a "differentiated retail" strategy.
Nike stock advanced 9% and is close to retaking its 50- and 200-day moving average lines that are currently priced around the 74.50 price level. Nike stock is moving up the right side of a new base after hitting a new seven-month low on Thursday. The stock's relative strength line is near a new high, signifying significant market outperformance, a bullish technical metric.
Dow Jones Stocks: Intel and Apple Stock Among the Dow Jones stocks , Intel ( INTC ) was one of the top-performing names in the Dow 30. The chipmaker rallied 1.5% but remains below its 50-day moving average line. The stock's RS line is improving, but the stock price remains about 20% off its 52-week high.
Meanwhile, Apple ( AAPL ) edged 0.2% higher in today's stock market action. Apple stock declined 11 of the last 12 weeks, taking the iPhone maker 33% off its all-time high.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Xilinx Looks For Support Among the leading growth stocks , top chip stock Xilinx ( XLNX ) is attempting to remain above its 10-week line . Shares moved up 0.1% Friday. The stock's RS line hit a new high this week, but the stock price finally succumbed to the general market's sell-off.
On the downside, Atlassian ( TEAM ) narrowed its early loss to 0.4%. The leading software stock is approaching a cup with handle's 89.92 buy point after finding support at the 50-day line Thursday. The RS line hit a new high Thursday, as the stock shrugged off the market weakness to rise 1.5%.
